scope: Knoy-only evidence and uncertainty revision; source model geometry, placement, transforms, and materials unchanged.

independent_review_disagreement.agreement: Both reviews found the modeled continuous repeated facade ribbons differ from narrow interrupted slit-like windows visible in the archival photograph.
independent_review_disagreement.facade_measurement: The R17 1.40 m glass height is qualitative and unmeasured; image perspective and absent face registration prevent assigning it as-built or to all elevations.
independent_review_disagreement.response: No selected-elevation interruptions were added because assigning the visible photo pattern to GIS segments is not supportable from the uncalibrated source.

sources.title: Purdue Archives, Historic Facilities and Buildings Database: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology

sources.does_not_support: Measured window dimensions, story-to-window registration, all-sided cadence, facade-face identity, or current date condition.
